overall_reason: The stacked windows use a lavender-grey #e8e5ef ground stepped to #f2f1f4 windows, a dusty plum #62547e on the one action 'Publish release', and a sage #527764 on the done checks.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE, T-ACCENT-DOSAGE and T-SURFACE-LADDER pass (one action hue, one state hue, receding windows dimmed, the front window brightest); T-PALETTE-ROLES finds six text greys.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: window text across the three windows, 1440, C:\Users\warwicka\Documents\unslop-runs-set2\P53\01-evidence\tiles\1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table finds 6 text levels on one light ground: #262628, #35414a, #8c8998, #9895a3, #a5a2ae and the sage #527764; part of the spread comes from dimming the two receding windows.
findings.before: Six text greys, several within a few per cent of each other (#8c8998, #9895a3, #a5a2ae)
findings.after: Three text greys for the front window; the receding windows dimmed by one shared step, not by new greys
findings.why: Close greys with no clear role make the set harder to keep consistent.

strengths: The plum #62547e marks only the primary action, and the sage #527764 only the done checks.
The front window is the lightest surface and the receding windows step down, so depth reads from lightness.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
